mentions.name: Kings Don't Stack
mentions.description: A Klondike solitaire game built with Godot, published on itch.io. It was created as an exercise to better understand Godot's inner workings, deliberately built without using LLMs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://matula.itch.io/kings-dont-stack

Klondike solitaire game using Godot. The goal is to better understand Godot's inner workings, and not using any LLMs... outside of whatever Google searches automatically popup when I have questions.
